title: Pitches from women that specify concrete goals for children's education or the pursuit of financial independence accelerate funding.
Female borrowers who include their age and number of children fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who include an explicit promise to repay the loan may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention improving soil fertility or protecting crops from pests may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who specify the exact number of sons and daughters may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention their age in their pitch may fund faster.
Female borrowers who explicitly mention dreams or hopes for the future may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention their marital status or spouse may fund faster.
Female borrowers who label themselves as deserving candidates for support fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who include a specific note about the accompanying photograph may fund faster.
Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention a history of successful loans from NWTF fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention existing asset ownership fund faster.
